title.narrative: Capacity for Change: Strengthening Justice Systems and Empowering Civil Society Organization’s for Environmental Advocacy

description.narrative: The Capacity for Change project aims to promote transformative change in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, by strengthening justice systems and empowering both civil society organizations (CSOs) and state actors in the realm of Human Rights and environmental advocacy. Funded by GP4, the project will be implemented in collaboration with the Mozambique Human Rights Defenders Network (RMDDH) and the Centro de Formação Jurídica e Judiciária (Centre for Judicial Training), under its current agreement with the Ministry of Justice, Constitutional, and Religious Affairs, and through a new Responsible Party Agreement (RPA).

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
